name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: A section that opens in place with the library's Collapse motion: it grows to its content's height and fades in, so what is below glides.
usage: Hide detail most people do not need until they ask: a request's headers, advanced playground parameters, a monitor's raw response. Put the trigger in the row it belongs to and turn a chevron with the state. For several sections where one opens at a time, use Accordion.
avoid: Hiding the main content of a page
A trigger with no visible state
Nesting collapsibles more than one level

reference.source: src/components/dashboard-ui/collapse.tsx (the library collapse motion); context-dashboard c0ddf7a src/components/usage/usage-page.tsx (rows that open in place with a turning chevron)
